question: Choose the correct one word substitution for: "A belief that the universe and all existence are divine"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pantheism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pantheism"** refers to the belief that the universe and all existence are divine, meaning that God or divinity is present in everything around us. (सर्वेश्वरवाद)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The philosophy of pantheism emphasizes the interconnectedness of all living beings and the universe as a manifestation of divine power.
 
 
 
• **"Pantheism"** often equates the concept of God with the universe itself, suggesting that everything is a part of the divine essence. (सर्वेश्वरवाद)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Many ancient cultures practiced pantheism by worshipping nature as divine.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pantheism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Polytheism** (बहुदेववाद): The belief in or worship of multiple gods.
 
 
 
• **Example:** Ancient Greeks practiced polytheism, worshipping gods like Zeus, Athena, and Apollo.
 
 

 
• **Mysticism** (रहस्यवाद): The belief or practice involving seeking direct communion with divine or spiritual truths, often through meditation or contemplation.
 
 
 
• **Example:** Mysticism is common in many religious traditions, where individuals seek personal experiences of the divine.
 
 

 
• **Agnosticism** (अज्ञेयवाद): The belief that the existence of God or the divine is unknown or unknowable.
 
 
 
• **Example:** He adopted agnosticism because he felt that the existence of God could neither be proven nor disproven.
